verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo is under 'facebook/react' and community discussion (react-comm-1/2/4/9) about the BSD+Patents license controversy makes clear React is single-company (Meta/Facebook) governed rather than foundation-governed, letting a developer infer lock-in risk. However, there is no explicit governance statement, no mention of any foundation transfer, and no first-party documentation addressing continuity/lock-in directly. Missing for 10: explicit governance/foundation statement, first-party continuity assurances, independent analysis of Meta's stewardship model.
